# scourer — realism QA repair

Angular compressed porous wire aggregate; irregular curls; coarse rigid fallback only.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f0168, f0008, f0149. Mean silhouette IoU 0.6992. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/scourer_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/scourer/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=C, proportions=C, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=C, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Replaced orderly torus-like coils with irregular scrunched core and 1,100 fine disordered wire curls.
- Marked porous aggregate deformable and distinguished effective modulus from solid steel.
- Refined size and position; retained a rigid convex fallback.

## Remaining

- Fine wire silhouette and porous appearance remain approximate.
- Single convex fallback cannot resolve individual wire contacts or compression.
- No deformable solver integration; aggregate modulus is tentative.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.

- Preserved colour transforms, glass IOR/optical thickness/absorption and metal anisotropy in portable GLB material extensions; procedural bump/SSS remain renderer-dependent.
- Re-measured source depth with ktools in all three review frames; retained depth/calibration uncertainty.
- Replaced unexplained mass priors with explicit constituent volume × density or textile-area budgets; synchronized part masses and COM metadata.
- Added portable MJCF rigid contacts and checked all convex collision meshes.
- Reconstructed the irregular scrunched outline from three silhouettes, constrained to the original local bounds.
- Replaced sparse round coils with 6500 fine, flattened irregular steel curls and a recessed dark porous interior.
- Replaced the single convex lump with four local hulls; added a volumetric FEM aggregate test.

Remaining:

- Coils/porosity are synthesized; individual-wire compression/friction is not modeled.
- Mass, friction, restitution and stiffness remain estimates, not measured physical calibration.
- Coarse FEM scene is separate from the detailed GLB; dynamic skinning, bending/tearing and real constitutive calibration remain incomplete.
